model_annotations.Bulgarian: Тази стълбовидна диаграма илюстрира точността (в проценти) на шест различни метода върху три бенчмарка. Хоризонталната ос съдържа три категории бенчмаркове: Mathverse, MMLU и Physics, подредени отляво надясно. Вертикалната ос представлява точността в проценти (Accuracy (%)) с линейна скала, обхващаща диапазон от приблизително 50% до 62%, с деления през 2 процентни пункта (50, 52, 54, 56, 58, 60, 62). За всяка категория бенчмарк са представени шест групирани стълбове, съответстващи на шест метода, обозначени в легендата: DAPO+Self-reflection (плътен син), DAPO (син с диагонални щрихи), SRPO (плътен оранжев), GRPO (оранжев с диагонални щрихи), PPO+Self-reflection (плътен тъмнозелен) и PPO (зелен с диагонални щрихи). За бенчмарка Mathverse стойностите са приблизително: DAPO+Self-reflection ~53.1%, DAPO ~56.1%, SRPO ~53.5%, GRPO ~55.8%, PPO+Self-reflection ~53.3% и PPO ~54.5%. За MMLU стойностите са приблизително: DAPO+Self-reflection ~55.8%, DAPO ~57.0%, SRPO ~55.8%, GRPO ~57.1%, PPO+Self-reflection ~54.8% и PPO ~56.2%. За Physics стойностите са приблизително: DAPO+Self-reflection ~57.5%, DAPO ~58.1%, SRPO ~60.5%, GRPO ~60.8%, PPO+Self-reflection ~56.8% и PPO ~59.1%. Стълбовете са подредени в рамките на всяка група в един и същ ред, следвайки последователността от легендата. Визуално щрихованите стълбове (DAPO, GRPO, PPO) се отличават от плътните стълбове (DAPO+Self-reflection, SRPO, PPO+Self-reflection), като щрихите представляват диагонални линии върху съответния цвят. Най-високите стълбове се наблюдават в групата Physics, където GRPO достига приблизително 60.8%, докато най-ниските стойности са в групата Mathverse, където DAPO+Self-reflection е около 53.1%.
model_annotations.Chinese: 该柱状图展示了六种不同方法在三个基准数据集上的准确率表现。水平轴为类别轴，包含三个数据集类别，从左到右依次为"Mathverse"、"MMLU"和"Physics"。垂直轴为数值轴，标签为"Accuracy (%)"，刻度范围从50%到62%，刻度间隔为2个百分点。图表中包含六种方法的分组柱状图，每个类别下并排排列六根柱子，分别对应图例中的六种方法：DAPO+Self-reflection（蓝色实心）、DAPO（蓝色斜线填充）、SRPO（橙色实心）、GRPO（橙色斜线填充）、PPO+Self-reflection（深绿色实心）和PPO（绿色斜线填充）。在"Mathverse"类别中，DAPO+Self-reflection约为53.1%，DAPO约为56.1%，SRPO约为53.5%，GRPO约为53.3%，PPO+Self-reflection约为55.8%，PPO约为54.5%。在"MMLU"类别中，DAPO+Self-reflection约为55.8%，DAPO约为57.0%，SRPO约为57.1%，GRPO约为56.0%，PPO+Self-reflection约为54.8%，PPO约为56.2%。在"Physics"类别中，DAPO+Self-reflection约为57.5%，DAPO约为58.1%，SRPO约为60.5%，GRPO约为56.2%，PPO+Self-reflection约为60.8%，PPO约为59.1%。总体来看，"Physics"类别下各方法的准确率普遍高于其他两个类别，其中PPO+Self-reflection在该类别中达到最高值约60.8%，而"Mathverse"类别中DAPO+Self-reflection的值约53.1%为全图最低。柱子按方法在图例中的顺序从左到右排列，未按数值大小排序，各方法通过颜色和填充纹理（实心与斜线）加以区分。
model_annotations.English: This bar chart illustrates the accuracy performance of six different methods across three benchmark datasets. The horizontal axis contains three categorical groups labeled "Mathverse," "MMLU," and "Physics," while the vertical axis represents "Accuracy (%)" on a linear scale ranging from approximately 50% to 62%, with tick marks at intervals of 2 percentage points. Within each benchmark group, six bars are displayed side by side, each corresponding to a different method as indicated by the legend: "DAPO+Self-reflection" (solid blue), "DAPO" (blue with diagonal hatching), "SRPO" (solid orange), "GRPO" (orange with diagonal hatching), "PPO+Self-reflection" (solid dark green), and "PPO" (green with diagonal hatching). For the Mathverse group, the bars show approximate values of 53.1% for DAPO+Self-reflection, 56.1% for DAPO, 53.5% for SRPO, 55.8% for SRPO-related GRPO, 53.3% for PPO+Self-reflection, and 54.5% for PPO. For the MMLU group, the approximate values are 55.8% for DAPO+Self-reflection, 57.0% for DAPO, 57.1% for SRPO, 56.0% for GRPO, 54.8% for PPO+Self-reflection, and 56.2% for PPO. For the Physics group, the values are notably higher overall, with approximately 57.5% for DAPO+Self-reflection, 58.1% for DAPO, 60.5% for SRPO, 61.0% for GRPO, 56.8% for PPO+Self-reflection, and 59.1% for PPO. The tallest bar in the chart appears in the Physics group for GRPO at roughly 61%, while the shortest bar is in the Mathverse group for DAPO+Self-reflection at approximately 53.1%. The bars are not sorted by value within each group but rather follow a consistent ordering by method across all three benchmarks. The use of hatching distinguishes the base methods (DAPO, GRPO, PPO) from their solid-colored counterparts, with solid fills used for the self-reflection variants and SRPO.
model_annotations.German: Dieses gruppierte Balkendiagramm veranschaulicht die Genauigkeit (Accuracy) verschiedener Trainingsmethoden auf drei unterschiedlichen Benchmarks. Die horizontale Achse enthält die drei Kategorien „Mathverse", „MMLU" und „Physics", während die vertikale Achse die Genauigkeit in Prozent darstellt, mit einer linearen Skala, die von 50 % bis 62 % reicht und in Schritten von 2 Prozentpunkten beschriftet ist. Für jeden Benchmark werden sechs Balken in einer Gruppe dargestellt, die jeweils einer Methode entsprechen: „DAPO+Self-reflection" (durchgehend blau), „DAPO" (blau schraffiert), „SRPO" (durchgehend orange), „GRPO" (orange schraffiert), „PPO+Self-reflection" (durchgehend dunkelgrün) und „PPO" (grün schraffiert). Im Benchmark „Mathverse" erreicht DAPO+Self-reflection etwa 53,1 %, DAPO etwa 56,1 %, SRPO etwa 53,5 %, GRPO etwa 55,8 %, PPO+Self-reflection etwa 53,3 % und PPO etwa 54,5 %. Im Benchmark „MMLU" liegen die Werte bei etwa 55,8 % für DAPO+Self-reflection, 57,0 % für DAPO, 57,1 % für SRPO, 56,0 % für GRPO, 54,8 % für PPO+Self-reflection und 56,2 % für PPO. Im Benchmark „Physics" zeigen sich die höchsten Werte insgesamt: DAPO+Self-reflection erreicht etwa 57,5 %, DAPO etwa 58,1 %, SRPO etwa 60,5 %, GRPO etwa 56,8 %, PPO+Self-reflection etwa 61,0 % und PPO etwa 59,1 %. Die Balken sind innerhalb jeder Gruppe in der Reihenfolge der Legende von links nach rechts angeordnet, wobei die durchgehend gefärbten Balken die Varianten mit Self-reflection bzw. die Basismethoden darstellen und die schraffierten Balken die jeweiligen Vergleichsmethoden ohne Self-reflection kennzeichnen. Es ist keine explizite Sortierung nach Balkenhöhe erkennbar, und keiner der Balken ist durch besondere visuelle Hervorhebungen wie Umrandungen oder Annotationen betont.
